motivation_letter.name: Goonja Gandhi
paragraphs: The Front-End Engineer role's emphasis on React and TypeScript points to challenges in crafting scalable UI architectures where reactivity and type safety prevent brittleness over time. This aligns with how I trace every framework choice back to the problem it solves — a habit formed studying Wittgenstein's shifts between rigid logical structures and fluid language games.

At Tata Consultancy Services, leading a team of five, I redesigned state management using RxJS and TypeScript, reducing unnecessary API calls by 40% while enforcing SOLID principles across enterprise interfaces. This not only improved data-heavy UIs through accordion-based systems but also clarified API contracts with backend teams, minimizing frontend bottlenecks.

Building NewsAlign, I shrank the React bundle from 941KB to under 300KB via code splitting and eliminated redundant calls, lifting Lighthouse scores from 73 to 95. Here, frontend gains depended on backend moves like scheduled pipelines over scraping, underscoring that true performance emerges from end-to-end reasoning.

My custom reactive JS engine, replicating useState with Object.defineProperty, grew from dissecting framework internals to inform real-world decisions. This perspective would help address the role's demands for optimized, maintainable systems.
motivation_letter.closing: Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute.
